caption:
You called the lead once. That's not a follow-up system.

Research on over 100,000 call attempts found reps who make 6 or more tries reach roughly 80% of prospects, while the average rep stops after 1.3 attempts.

Run this on every new lead this week:
1. Call within 5 minutes of the inquiry. Text if no answer.
2. Call again 1 hour later.
3. Day 2: one call and one text.
4. Day 3: a final call and text.

Space attempts 1 to 2 days apart once you're past day one. That gap produces the highest contact rates in the data.

Run a free check on your own response speed.
